QuestInfo.name: Den Expedition 2
QuestInfo.0: Bluffing Tom wants to find more pouches. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Bluffing Tom asked you to get 30 #t4034004# items from #m866000140#.
QuestInfo.2: You handed Bluffing Tom the #t4034004# you found in #m866000130#.

0.msg: This is the last time I'll be fooled by you!

1.msg: I swear I'm right this time! Don't make that face again. C'mon, trust me!

3.msg: Let me know when you find it!

yes.0: I mean it this time! Just tell me when you've got all the items I asked for!

no.0: I thought we were friends...\r\nTalk to me when you're ready to be a TRUE friend.

1.msg: There it is! My mom's handkerchief! To tell you the truth, which I ALWAYS do, my mom's been missing for a while. I was out searching for her when I ran into kobolds.

2.msg: But nobody believed me when I told them!

3.msg: Oh, so that's the story. Well gee, now I feel bad...

4.msg: But now I know for sure. The kobolds kidnapped my mom!
